WITH observatory_counts AS (
    SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
),
observatory_shares AS (
    SELECT
        telescope_count,
        CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM observatory_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share
    FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
    AVG(os.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
    AVG(os.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(os.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average
FROM observatory_shares AS os
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE os.share > a.share

WITH observatory_counts AS (
    SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
    FROM observatories AS o
    LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation
),
observatory_shares AS (
    SELECT
        telescope_count,
        1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM observatory_counts), 0) AS share
    FROM observatory_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
    AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average
FROM observatory_shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.share

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT
    telescope_count,
    1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
shares_with_average AS (
  SELECT
    telescope_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG((share - average_share) / average_share) AS average_relative_excess
FROM shares_with_average
WHERE share > average_share
